meaning:
§ Beth-millo = "house of Millo" or "house of the rampart"
a place near Shechem

elsewhere.note: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.
His servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
